independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG3 scope. This round I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-1/e2e/dg3-qa-r1.spec.ts (outside the candidate, because the candidate is frozen), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-1/, this record and its narrative. Every result comes from my own runs in one disposable clone of the source commit 928b7654 under $TMPDIR (review-dg3), removed at the end with all test scratch. HEAD was ec45ef1b at the start (the round-1 freeze and assignment commit, a child of 928b7654 touching only the three assignments, the candidate manifest, progress.md and stages.json) and 1471fd40 at the end (other reviewers' auto-commits). None of the 128 files changed in 928b7654..HEAD is among the 753 manifest entries, and the candidate ID recomputes identical at the start, at the end, at --ref 928b7654 and in the clone. I did not open any other reviewer's round-1 record or evidence; I formed this verdict from my own runs.

checks_run.actual: At the start HEAD was ec45ef1b, a child of 928b7654 (is-ancestor exit 0) whose diff is the three round-1 assignments, the manifest, progress.md and stages.json.
